```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
split_paths <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(x)
  if (is.null(x) || is.na(x) || x == "") return(character(0))
  strsplit(x, " +")[[1]]  # uno o más espacios
}

get_sample <- function(path) {
  parts <- strsplit(path, .Platform$file.sep)[[1]]
  parts[length(parts) - 1]
}

iframe_html <- function(path, height = 550) {
  sprintf('<iframe src="%s" width="100%%" height="%d" style="border:none;"></iframe>',
          path, height)
}

pre_stats  <- split_paths(params$pre_stats)
post_stats <- split_paths(params$post_stats)
pre_ybl    <- split_paths(params$pre_ybl)
post_ybl   <- split_paths(params$post_ybl)
pre_lvq    <- split_paths(params$pre_lvq)
post_lvq   <- split_paths(params$post_lvq)

# Alinea todo por sample (por si acaso)
samples <- vapply(pre_stats, get_sample, FUN.VALUE = character(1))
ord <- order(samples)

pre_stats  <- pre_stats[ord]
post_stats <- post_stats[ord]
pre_ybl    <- pre_ybl[ord]
post_ybl   <- post_ybl[ord]
pre_lvq    <- pre_lvq[ord]
post_lvq   <- post_lvq[ord]
samples    <- samples[ord]
                    
knitr::opts_knit$set(
  root.dir = rprojroot::find_rstudio_root_file()
)
```

## Load Packages

library(htmltools)

# Goals of file:

1. Analizar la calidad pre y post QC con nanoplot.
